page: Microsoft Azure EC32eds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECEDV6 family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server is equipped with 1890 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs, making it a CPU-only instance.

From a resource density perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large in-memory footprints without the overhead of excess compute cores. The combination of dedicated Intel vCPUs, substantial RAM, and local storage makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, in-memory caching, and data analytics workloads.
